headline: Utah Valley goes through the conference unbeaten
dek: Utah Valley went through conference play without a defeat and has won fifteen matches in all. Behind it, Cal State Fullerton and UC San Diego sit level on points.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring alone does not order the table: Long Beach State has outscored UC San Diego and still sits below it.

wire.line: All five of Utah Valley's losses came against sides from outside the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches from the season's opening week still have no published result, involving UC Riverside, Cal Poly, CSUN and Sacramento State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: California Baptist has scored 25 goals and conceded 11 across all its matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Charlotte Wilfert has recorded nine shutouts in goal for UC San Diego.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State Bakersfield has won two matches and lost fifteen.

last_match.line: Utah State is the only opponent to beat Utah Valley twice this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
